message:
good route for an afternoon ride. here's how i'd break it up:

first stop, [Finns Beach Club](kebi://venue/c61dd547-cc0d-452a-a5d2-f13d3751d1c6) in Berawa, right at the start of your ride heading south. it's open every day so no timing issue, good for a drink or a bite before the longer stretch. easy to pop in, not a commitment.

from there, keep riding south through Seminyak and Kuta, and if you want a beach pause before you hit the cliffs, [Pererenan Beach](kebi://venue/296fc237-d1fd-4d25-abbc-9f20bce6ee6e) is a mellow pull-off right at the start of the corridor, or Balangan is a nice quiet one closer to Uluwatu that rewards the extra few minutes off the main road.

then when you arrive, [Single Fin](kebi://venue/2c41a3f7-c5cb-4782-b441-a8535825c865) is the classic first stop in Uluwatu, right on the cliff above the break. at 3pm you've got a few hours before sunset, so you can grab a spot, watch the surf, and stay for the golden hour, it gets busy around 5-6 so arriving now means you get a good seat before the crowd rolls in. [Burnt at Ulu Cliffhouse](kebi://venue/13d8bb71-e05e-4b51-95db-c709aecae1c7) is right nearby too if you want something a bit more upscale for a late afternoon drink or early dinner.

that's a solid shape: Finns on the way out of [Canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu), Balangan if you want a beach break, then Single Fin for sunset. what's the plan once you get to Uluwatu, staying the night or riding back?
